planning.assumed: Required M-MEAS-03 (centimetre and ruler interval). Iteration/tiling applied procedurally; no extra M-MEAS-01 hard gate, conversion fluency, fraction or object naming demand. Screen geometry not physical cm calibration.
planning.scope: All target lengths6cm; targets0..6 or2..8 in model coordinates. Selected piece1cm or2cm, maximum8 pieces within0..12cm drawing; positions editable in1cm steps. Report6cm or correct number of selected-size pieces. No fractional remainder piece.
planning.interaction: Constructive layout has individual piece-start controls, add/remove and shared geometry. Check sorted coverage, then report value/unit; arbitrary row order accepted. Detect gap, overlap, start/end faults separately. A correct numeral cannot hide bad layout. Both6cm and correctly named piece count accepted. Helper boundary overlay preserves still-valid answer.
planning.evidenceLimits: Virtual tiling and reported measurement do not verify physical alignment, ruler handling, reading strategy, independence or learning efficacy.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Canonical roles/grade/groups/curriculum refs are frozen curriculum facts. Finite scenes, controls and lesson sequencing are original project design; external comparables corroborate concepts, not new normative graph facts or efficacy.
